backup.production_rule: Guest guide v8.0.0 backend (s135), additive only: five tables guide_threads, guide_sessions, guide_messages, guide_auth_attempts, guide_events (RLS on, no policies, no grants to anon or authenticated); four guest RPCs (guide_session_v1, guide_thread_v1, guide_send_v1, guide_track_v1; anon and authenticated, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path empty); six staff RPCs (staff_guide_threads_v1, staff_guide_thread_v1, staff_guide_reply_v1, staff_guide_resolve_v1, staff_guide_usage_v1, staff_guide_guests_v1; authenticated only, gated by current_staff_authorized('manage_guest_inbox'); a missing thread id raises P0002 before the 42501 access check); the token helper and the push trigger function have no client and no service_role grant, guide_sweep_v1 is service_role only; no guide or staff guide function is executable by service_role except guide_sweep_v1 (no edge function calls them; the trigger runs without an execute check at fire time); trigger guide_messages_push on guide_messages calls notify-staff-inbox through pg_net and the vault secret and never fails the insert. guide_session_v1 refuses a booking whose name is a placeholder (reason no_name, no thread), keys its per-address throttle on cf-connecting-ip, else x-real-ip, else the rightmost x-forwarded-for entry (each trimmed and accepted only when address-shaped, ^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{2,45}$; else the client id), allows 8 failures per address and 10 failures per check-in date per 15 minutes and 20 sessions per thread per day (reason busy), serialises mints per check-in date with an advisory lock, and refuses a stay whose token would already be past its Manila expiry (reason expired, no session); guide_track_v1 caps events per device (600/hour) and globally (300/minute and 20000 per rolling 24 hours, then drops silently: ok, stored 0) by arrival time, takes a global advisory lock before the cap counts, and keeps only whitelisted short scalar meta values (meta over 200 serialised bytes becomes {}); a search_empty event keeps the guest's single-token search term in target (max 80 chars) and the staff usage report shows it to staff; guide_sweep_v1 keeps events 90 days; staff_guide_usage_v1 answers only for the default property (single-property, other ids get an empty flagged object); staff_guide_guests_v1(p_days, property) lists the guests who signed in to the guide (first name plus last initial only, last_seen within p_days clamped 1..90, newest first, 60 rows, total uncapped; default property only, other ids get {guests: [], single_property: true}; execute for authenticated only, service_role revoked, like every staff guide function); service_role has explicit full access to the five tables and the two identity sequences are closed to anon and authenticated. No existing table, function or setting is touched; verify_booking is called, not replaced. Phase is backfill, not expand, only because the body of guide_sweep_v1 contains DELETE FROM (housekeeping of the new tables), which release-safety refuses in an expand migration; the migration itself deletes no existing row and writes no data.
backup.notes: Apply after s134 and cf_confirm_flow (20261205000000) are applied; re-timed from 20261205000000 to 20261206000000 in s136 because cf_confirm_flow holds 20261205000000 live. The migration carries no begin/commit of its own (the runner wraps it). Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour). After the apply add select public.guide_sweep_v1() to the weekly sweep (or a pg_cron job guide-sweep-weekly) and confirm notify-staff-inbox accepts {kind guest_wrote, psid guide:<uuid>} from the database caller. The Staff app Guide inbox and the guide v8.0.0 frontend follow the SQL. Storage bound: guide_events is bounded at about 20000 rows a day and 1.8 million rows at the 90-day retention; a batch may overshoot a cap by up to 49 events. Guest-facing reasons and the post-apply check are listed under notes and post_apply_check.

forward_verification.name: guide_tables_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 5 from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('guide_threads','guide_sessions','guide_messages','guide_auth_attempts','guide_events')

forward_verification.name: guide_rls_on_all_five
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(c.relrowsecurity) and count(*) = 5 from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relname in ('guide_threads','guide_sessions','guide_messages','guide_auth_attempts','guide_events')

forward_verification.name: guide_anon_has_no_table_grants
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from information_schema.role_table_grants where grantee in ('anon','authenticated') and table_schema = 'public' and table_name like 'guide\_%')

forward_verification.name: guide_anon_may_not_call_staff_functions
forward_verification.query: select not bool_or(has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.staff_guide_threads_v1(uuid)','public.staff_guide_thread_v1(uuid)','public.staff_guide_reply_v1(uuid,text,text)','public.staff_guide_resolve_v1(uuid,boolean)','public.staff_guide_usage_v1(integer,uuid)','public.staff_guide_guests_v1(integer,uuid)','public.guide_token_thread_v1(text)','public.guide_sweep_v1()']::regprocedure[]) f

forward_verification.name: guide_guests_report_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_guide_guests_v1(integer,uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_guide_guests_v1(integer,uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_guide_guests_v1(integer,uuid)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: guide_definer_functions_pin_search_path
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']) and count(*) >= 13 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and (p.proname like 'guide\_%' or p.proname like 'staff\_guide\_%')

forward_verification.name: guide_push_trigger_present
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_trigger where tgname = 'guide_messages_push' and not tgisinternal)

forward_verification.name: guide_service_role_executes_only_the_sweep
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.guide_sweep_v1()', 'execute') and (select not bool_or(has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.guide_session_v1(date,text,text,uuid)','public.guide_thread_v1(text,timestamptz)','public.guide_send_v1(text,text,text)','public.guide_track_v1(text,jsonb,text,text)','public.guide_token_thread_v1(text)','public.guide_messages_push_trg()','public.staff_guide_threads_v1(uuid)','public.staff_guide_thread_v1(uuid)','public.staff_guide_reply_v1(uuid,text,text)','public.staff_guide_resolve_v1(uuid,boolean)','public.staff_guide_usage_v1(integer,uuid)','public.staff_guide_guests_v1(integer,uuid)']::regprocedure[]) f)

forward_verification.name: guide_service_role_has_full_table_access
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.' || t, p)) from unnest(array['guide_threads','guide_sessions','guide_messages','guide_auth_attempts','guide_events']) t, unnest(array['select','insert','update','delete']) p

forward_verification.name: guide_identity_sequences_closed_to_clients
forward_verification.query: select not bool_or(has_sequence_privilege(r, 'public.' || q, p)) from unnest(array['anon','authenticated']) r, unnest(array['guide_auth_attempts_id_seq','guide_events_id_seq']) q, unnest(array['usage','select','update']) p

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (verify_booking, current_staff_authorized or calendar_events missing, or public.guide_threads already exists)

the rehearsal has not run the migration (apply, rollback, apply again, forward checks after each) and the suite guide_v8_messages_analytics on this commit, or any test fails outside the accepted_failing_tests lists, or compatibility.verified is still false
notify-staff-inbox has not been checked to accept kind guest_wrote with a guide:<uuid> psid from the database caller (the push would be silent, the messages still arrive)
post_apply_check: Orchestrator, right after apply: one guide_session_v1 call with a wrong initial from the orchestrator PC; read-only SQL (select client, ok, at from public.guide_auth_attempts order by at desc limit 1) reads the newest guide_auth_attempts key (column client); it must equal that PC's public IP (shape ip:<address>), not a Cloudflare/Supabase address. If it is a shared address, raise the per-IP cap via hotfix before announcing.

guest_facing_reasons: throttled (guide_session_v1): 8 failed sign-ins from this address, or 10 failed sign-ins for this check-in date, in the last 15 minutes; checked first, so even the right initial is refused until the window passes.
no_name (guide_session_v1): the booking's name is a placeholder (Reserved / Airbnb / Not / empty), so any initial would match; no session is minted, the guest is pointed at Airbnb messaging.
busy (guide_session_v1): the stay's thread already has 20 sessions minted in the last 24 hours.
too_early (guide_session_v1): check-in is more than 3 days ahead; the answer carries opens_on = check-in minus 3.
expired (guide_session_v1): verify_booking says the stay is over (checkout + 1 day passed, UTC date), or the session's own expiry (Manila midnight of checkout + 2 days) has already passed.
session (guide_thread_v1, guide_send_v1): the token is unknown, malformed or past expires_at; the guide must sign in again.

rate (guide_send_v1): the guest sent 30 messages in the last hour on this thread (staff replies have their own cap of 60; guide_track_v1 also answers rate at 600 events an hour per device, silent for the guest).
also: missing (blank initial), no_match (no booking or wrong initial), length (message empty or over 2000 characters), client_msg_id (outside 8 to 80 characters).
